title: RIFT Landslide Hazard Model v2 Feature Schema
description: Strict physical geomorphological feature requirements for reliable spatial inference.

slope_deg.description: Terrain slope angle derived from DEM or field survey.

soil_moisture_source_value.description: Volumetric or satellite soil moisture reading.

NDVI.description: Normalized Difference Vegetation Index from optical satellite imagery.

distance_to_urban_center_km.description: Distance to nearest reference urban center or major human settlement.

Latitude.description: Geographic latitude (used strictly for spatial density query, NOT fed to decision trees).

Longitude.description: Geographic longitude (used strictly for spatial density query, NOT fed to decision trees).

engineered_features.dist_to_nearest_landslide_km: Spherical Haversine distance to closest confirmed historical landslide in GSI catalog
engineered_features.historical_landslide_density_10km: Count of confirmed historical landslides within 10 km buffer

excluded_features: Material_Involved (excluded to allow predictive assessment prior to slope failure)
Movement_Type (excluded because failure type is unknown prior to event)
